correctness.rationale: The nonzero proper ideals of Z/(p^a q^b) are exponent pairs excluding (0,0),(a,b); I_ij ∩ I_kl is zero iff max(i,k)=a and max(j,l)=b. This gives the complete 3-class decomposition K_(ab-1) join (K_a disjoint_union K_b), with (1,1) exactly 2 isolates. True twins prevent two initial whites in the same class; one white in every class stalls; all pairs in distinct classes force, giving E=ab+(a+b)(ab-1) minimum sets and polynomial E u^(N-2)+N u^(N-1)+u^N. The vectors (1,0),(0,1),(1,1) yield rank-two real Gram pattern and connected noncomplete excludes rank one. At equal degree N and coefficient E, writing s=a+b,t=ab forces (s-s')(N-1-s-s')=0; unequal sums give t'=s+2,s'=t-2 and the all-exponents>=2 bounds or (gamma-1)(delta-1)=6 when an exponent is 1, leaving only pairs (1,9)~(3,4),(1,11)~(2,7). Independently simulated every initial zero forcing set for pairs (1,1),(1,2),(1,3),(2,2),(2,3); coefficient vectors matched, and checked both collision formulas. The finite tests are not the infinite Diophantine argument.
